import random

def reservoir_seed(stream, k, seed):
    if k < 0:
        return []
    random.seed(seed)
    n = len(stream)
    if k >= n:
        return stream[:]
    selected_indices = []
    for i, item in enumerate(stream):
        if len(selected_indices) < k:
            selected_indices.append(i)
        else:
            j = random.randint(0, i)
            if j < k:
                selected_indices[j] = i
    selected_indices.sort()
    return [stream[i] for i in selected_indices]
